title: Liberales y conservadores
goal: Read what liberals and conservatives actually fought over — the Church's property and role, secular education, and why neither side won a lasting victory.

items: Name three concrete issues liberals and conservatives disagreed over.
Explain why liberals saw the Church's property as an obstacle to economic progress.
Describe what liberals and conservatives did when elections went against them.
Explain whether either side achieved a lasting, definitive victory.
Use an opening gerund to state a group's goal or simultaneous actions.
